The project will build and support the national HMIS and reporting of notifiable diseases of national concern for appropriate action. This will involve building the capacity of the health care service providers to getting adequate knowledge on emergency response.lt/spangtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-GB"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltp style="mso-margin-top-alt:automso-margin-bottom-alt: automso-add-space:autotext-indent:-18.0ptline-height:normalmso-list:l0 level1 lfo1" class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast"gtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-GB"gt6.ltspan style="font-family:"gt lt/spangtlt/spangtltspan style="font-family:"gtIntegration of Mental Health/Psycho-social Support (MHPSS) services, community engagement, and health education to community members to enhance identification and referral of persons of concern in need of MHPSS while also conducting a focused MHPSS intervention through trained social workers. Conduct psycho-education sessions for persons in need, including raising awareness on key protection risks faced by PSNs i.e. discrimination, stigma. The MHSS team will consist of, midwife and PSS counsellor.lt/spangtltspan style="font-family:" lang="EN-GB"gtlt/spangtlt/pgt
ltpgtltspan style="line-height: 107% font-family:"gtAamin, through complementary support of its EPHS project supported by UNICEF will complement the project referrals services in the target area of Kahda. The free ambulance services will be utilized to increase access to emergency and pre- hospital services for trauma patients. Additionally, the community will be sensitized on hygiene promotion measures with a focus on proper hand washing with soap, safe waste and excreta disposal and household (HH) water treatment and safe storage and need to seek health care services when sick. Robust coordination between the health cluster at National and State level will be maintained in addition to the ongoing key health actors in Kahda districts. The project will address gender issues through collecting sex and age disaggregated data which will be analyzed to identify gaps provide gender sensitive interventions and ensure participation and empowerment of women. Protection of beneficiaries will be ensured during access and utilization of services seeking to reduce further risks.lt/spangtlt/pgt
